MP3 encoding uses @breezystack/lamejs 1.2.7 (LAME), by Alex Zhukov and contributors.
License: GNU Lesser General Public License v3.0 (LGPL-3.0).
LAME project: https://lame.sourceforge.net/
Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@breezystack/lamejs/v/1.2.7
Source: https://github.com/gideonstele/lamejs/tree/1fb0ef5fa177413107e2e107d054a9b994e3f79c

lamejs.js is distributed unmodified from the package's dist/lamejs.js.
The encoder is loaded only when creating MP3, as an independent same-origin
ES module, outside the application bundles. No audio is sent to a server.

The corresponding source archive is source-1.2.7.tar.gz in this directory.
COPYING.LESSER.txt and COPYING.txt contain the LGPLv3 and GPLv3 texts.
UPSTREAM-LICENSE.txt and UPSTREAM-README.md retain the author's notices.

Replacement: replace /vendor/lamejs/lamejs.js with an interface-compatible
ES module exporting Mp3Encoder(channels, sampleRate, kbps), whose instances
provide encodeBuffer(Int16Array) and flush(). Rebuilding the application is
not required to replace this file. You may modify and debug the library
under the terms of its license. No modifications were made to it here.
